auth.mustChangePassword: You must change your password to continue.
auth.mustChangePasswordBody: This account is still using a first-run or administrator-reset password. Choose a new one to continue.
auth.mustChangePasswordScope: Until the password is changed, the dashboard, customer and staff records, financial data, AI settings, export and backup are all closed. The first-run account can only sign in from the device the server runs on.

compliance.unknownIsNotCompliant: An unknown finding is not counted as compliant.
compliance.disclaimerTitle: This screen is not legal advice
compliance.disclaimerBody: What you see here are technical findings, evidence states and the human review queue. The final assessment belongs to the data protection officer and legal counsel.

overview.title: Compliance Status
overview.subtitle: Category states, missing evidence and the human review queue — no single score
overview.missingEvidenceHint: A control with no evidence is not a closed control
overview.pendingHumanReviewHint: A person decides these; the engine cannot close them itself
overview.decisionsWithoutAppeal: Automated decisions with no appeal path
overview.decisionsWithoutAppealHint: The affected person has no stated way to challenge the decision
overview.awaitingReviewCount: {{count}} controls are waiting on a human
overview.noCategoriesHint: Categories appear here once a rule pack has been approved.
overview.noAttentionHint: This does not mean everything is compliant — only that no finding is currently open.
overview.chainBroken: Evidence chain is broken at entry {{id}}.
overview.chainUnknown: The evidence chain has not been verified yet.

inventory.title: Personal Data Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Fields found by the scan and the human classification recorded against them
inventory.candidateNotice: The scanner only produces candidates; the final classification belongs to a person. An unknown field is not counted as compliant.
inventory.emptyHint: Fields appear here once the discovery scan has run.

consents.title: Notices and Consent
consents.subtitle: Privacy notices and consent records are kept apart
consents.separationTitle: Informing and consent are separate acts
consents.separationBody: Informing people is an obligation that stands whether or not they consent. Consent is given freely and can be withdrawn at any time. The two cannot be bundled into a single checkbox, so they live in separate tabs and separate records.
consents.noNoticesHint: No privacy notice has been published yet.
consents.noticeTextMissing: The text of this version is not stored — the evidence is missing.
consents.subject: Data subject
consents.noConsentsHint: No consent record matches this filter.
consents.withdrawExplain: The consent {{subject}} gave for {{purpose}} will be withdrawn.
consents.withdrawAppendOnly: The withdrawal is appended as a new record; the original grant is not deleted and stays as evidence of what happened when.

dsr.title: Data Subject Requests
dsr.subtitle: Access, rectification, erasure and objection requests, with their deadlines
dsr.identityTitle: No answer before identity is verified
dsr.identityBody: Handing data to an unverified requester is itself a disclosure, so identity verification is tracked here as a field of its own.
dsr.subject: Data subject
dsr.subjectHint: Customer code, username or the identifier given in the request
dsr.contactHint: Where the answer will be sent
dsr.detailPlaceholder: Record what the person asked for, in their own words
dsr.createNotice: The clock starts the moment the request is saved, and the record is written to the audit trail.
dsr.transitionNoteHint: The note is appended to the record and cannot be deleted

rulePacks.title: Rule Packs
rulePacks.subtitle: Versioned obligation sets and their approval flow
rulePacks.approvalTitle: An unapproved pack does not take effect
rulePacks.approvalBody: The engine binds only to a version a named person approved. Unverified citations are not hidden; the approver has to acknowledge them explicitly.
rulePacks.unverifiedWarning: This pack still has {{count}} unverified citations. An unverified citation is not evidence of compliance.
rulePacks.decisionNoteHint: The note is stored with the decision and shows up in the audit trail
rulePacks.acknowledgeUnverified: I know this version still contains {{count}} unverified citations and I approve it as it stands.
rulePacks.emptyHint: No rule pack matches this filter.

hsp.title: Rights Receipts
hsp.subtitle: For every decision made about a person: what was asked, what was decided, why, under which policy, when, and how to appeal
hsp.bannerTitle: A timeout is not a silent pass
hsp.bannerBody: When no applicable policy is found, or the evaluation runs out of time, the decision is written as an explicit denial. The appeal path is shown on every receipt, including the allowed ones.
hsp.searchPlaceholder: Receipt reference, data subject or question code
hsp.subject: Data subject
hsp.timeoutExplain: Evaluation went past the {{ms}} ms limit. Rather than quietly allowing it, the decision was recorded as an explicit denial.
hsp.noPolicyExplain: No approved policy could be applied to this question. The absence of a policy is not permission, so the decision was recorded as a denial.
hsp.appealPathBody: You can challenge this decision. An appeal does not erase the decision; it is recorded alongside it and reviewed by a person.
hsp.appealChannelUnknown: No channel defined — contact the data protection officer
hsp.appealExplain: You are appealing the decision recorded in receipt {{reference}}.
hsp.appealAppendOnly: The appeal is appended next to the receipt. The original decision stays exactly as it was taken.
hsp.appealReasonHint: Explain why the decision is wrong
hsp.appealContactHint: Where the review result will be sent
hsp.appealSubmitted: Appeal recorded and queued for human review.
hsp.appealDeadlinePassed: The appeal window has closed. You can still contact the data protection officer.
hsp.appealOffline: You are not able to file an appeal from inside the app. Use the channel listed above.
hsp.emptyHint: A receipt shows up here whenever the engine decides something about a person.
